caption: The drawing depicts a single garment, a light brown, long-sleeved shirt dress with a collar and a button-down front. The dress is rendered with visible shading and cross-hatch lines to suggest texture and fabric folds. The sleeves are slightly tapered and end just above the wrist. The dress is A-line in shape, widening from the shoulders down to the hem, which curves gently at the bottom. There are seven visible buttons running vertically down the front center of the dress. The background is a plain, off-white color, and there is a handwritten signature at the bottom left that reads "Roberta Spicer."
title: Girl's Coat
